run_landmark_classifier: run the landmark classification model on TalkTheWalk dataset with resnet or fasttext features
run_nearest_neighbor_baseline: run a 1 nearest neighbor classifier baseline over extracted features for landmark classification
create_split_dataset: create a 70/30 train/validation split from a TalkTheWalk landmarks dataset using create_split
add_weights_class_imbalance: add inverse frequency weights to train and validation data for landmark class imbalance
eval_epoch_train_validate: evaluate a model epoch on a dataloader returning loss, f1, precision, and recall metrics
